name: Survey tile in Aquarius
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Aquarius, imaged by SPHEREx 8 times in 3 visits over 33 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 27 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.4 days starting 2025-11-10, at wavelengths from 1.35 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
